blocks.text: To edit a configured Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) group:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > Private Service Edge Groups.
In the table, locate the Private Service Edge group you want to modify and click the Edit icon.
Private Service Edge groups that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited.
The Private Service Edge Groups > Edit page appears.
In the Private Service Edge Groups > Edit page, you can modify any field.

blocks.text: When you disable Publicly Accessible without a trusted network, the IP address of the Private Service Edge is returned to the client for both on-premises and roaming users that are located closest to the Private Service Edge. To mitigate connectivity issues for remote users who want to connect to this Private Service Edge, ensure it’s reachable over a public IP address.
